item: Row 367 batch 2: Settings compact, rebuild, update and stoplist lines follow a language switch
summary: Ten frozen renderers in app-settings.js (vacuumNow, _rbPaint, _rbPaintLanes, rebuildNow, rebuildStoreNow, _updPaintInstall, updLoadStatus, updCheck, updApply, loadBuiltinStoplist) now draw through ooLive/ooLiveHtml from state they already hold, so a language switch redraws them with no request; their 10 lines leave configs/i18n_frozen_renderers.txt. No new strings. #rebuild-result has ONE render (_rbResultText) reading _rebuildSt and a new _rebuildNote (the refused or taken start, which was res.dataset.keep), so a switch never draws an older outcome over the refusal. A Remove of a kept file stays disabled through a redraw (_rbRemoving). The rebuild status-read error, the update check's version and its clear also go through the held nodes. Driven as real code by settings_safety_updates_live_node_test.js.
